# Cncf Red Hat Openshift On Ibm Cloud Reviewer

Review Red Hat OpenShift on IBM Cloud using its official documentation and repository in the Platform / Certified Kubernetes - Hosted category. Red Hat OpenShift on IBM Cloud is a managed offering to create your own OpenShift cluster of compute hosts to deploy and manage containerized apps on IBM Cloud.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
